_comment: Template for a theme mod. Copy this file, change name/defName/label/mod.packageId and the colours, replace the placeholders with your own images ("source": "path/relative/to/this/json.png"), then run: python -I -X utf8 make_theme.py ExampleTheme.json <output folder>. Every optional field is shown here so the generated Defs file is a complete reference. buttonImage puts a picture in every main button and buttonImages in named ones (button = the MainButtonDef defName); palette.hollow leaves the middle of the button frames empty so the pictures show through. Delete what you do not need.
name: ExampleTheme
label: example steel
description: Brushed steel with amber labels. An example theme that uses every field; the illustrations are placeholders.
